components.name: Primary Save Button
components.description: Commits the current room plan using the active drafting color.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 38px; padding: 0 17px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--blue, #2436d8); color: #fff; font: 700 13px "Avenir Next", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(36,54,216,.2); transition: .18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(.95); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6675ef; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Tool Icon Button
components.description: A square rail control with explicit selected and keyboard-focus states.
components.css: .ds-tool-button { width: 38px; height: 38px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #62667b; font-size: 19px; cursor: pointer; transition: .18s ease; } .ds-tool-button:hover { background: #f1f2f7; color: var(--blue, #2436d8); } .ds-tool-button.ds-active { background: var(--blue-soft, #eef0ff); color: var(--blue, #2436d8); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(36,54,216,.08); } .ds-tool-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6675ef; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tool-button:active { transform: scale(.96); }

components.name: View Switch
components.description: Selects plan, orthographic isometric, or perspective representation above the model.
components.css: .ds-view-switch { display: inline-flex; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(225,226,235,.95); border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.94); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(31,35,70,.08); } .ds-view-switch button { height: 32px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #777b90; font: 700 12px "Avenir Next", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-view-switch button:hover { color: var(--blue, #2436d8); } .ds-view-switch button.ds-active { background: var(--blue, #2436d8); color: #fff; } .ds-view-switch button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #2436d8); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-view-switch button:active { transform: scale(.98); }

components.name: Color Study Switch
components.description: Chooses blue, red, green, or colorless as a complete architectural study.
components.html: 线稿
components.css: .ds-color-switch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 5px 7px; border: 1px solid rgba(225,226,235,.92); border-radius: 11px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.92); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(31,35,70,.06); font-family: "Avenir Next", sans-serif; } .ds-color-switch > span { padding: 0 5px 0 2px; color: #85899a; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-color-switch button { height: 28px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 0 7px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: #777b8d; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 750; cursor: pointer; } .ds-color-switch button:hover { background: #f5f5f7; } .ds-color-switch button.ds-active { background: var(--blue-soft, #eef0ff); color: var(--blue, #2436d8); } .ds-color-switch button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #2436d8); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-color-switch button:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-color-switch i { width: 10px; height: 10px; border: 2px solid #fff; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(22,24,39,.18); } .ds-blue { background: #2549d8; } .ds-red { background: #df4053; } .ds-green { background: #2f8763; } .ds-mono { background: #555b61; }

components.name: Metric Input
components.description: Edits dimensions and clearances with an attached unit and tabular numerals.
components.css: .ds-metric-input { width: 110px; height: 31px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 0 7px; border: 1px solid #e7e8ef; border-radius: 8px; background: #f7f8fb; transition: border-color .16s ease, background .16s ease; } .ds-metric-input:hover { border-color: #cfd2e5; } .ds-metric-input:focus-within { border-color: #8994ef; background: #fff; outline: 2px solid #6675ef; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-metric-input input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #151729; font: 400 10px "Avenir Next", sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-metric-input span { color: #999cad; font: 400 8px "Avenir Next", sans-serif; }

components.name: Material Asset Card
components.description: Adds a line-art furniture or fixture object to the current room.
components.css: .ds-asset-card { width: 138px; min-height: 108px; padding: 10px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: flex-end; border: 1px solid #ececf3; border-radius: 13px; background: #fafafe; color: #151729; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; transition: .18s ease; } .ds-asset-card:hover { border-color: #b8beff; background: #f4f5ff; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 22px rgba(36,54,216,.08); } .ds-asset-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6675ef; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-asset-card:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-asset-card > span { flex: 1; align-self: center; display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--blue, #2436d8); font: 36px Georgia, serif; } .ds-asset-card b { margin-top: 4px; font: 700 11px "Avenir Next", sans-serif; } .ds-asset-card small { margin-top: 2px; color: #9699a9; font: 400 9px "Avenir Next", sans-serif; }

components.css: .ds-inspector { width: 304px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(228,229,237,.95); border-radius: 15px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.95); color: #151729; box-shadow: 0 18px 42px rgba(31,35,70,.14); font-family: "Avenir Next", sans-serif; backdrop-filter: blur(14px); } .ds-inspector header { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; padding-bottom: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e7e8ef; } .ds-inspector header span { color: #777b90; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-inspector header b { font-size: 13px; } .ds-inspector header small { color: #989baa; font-size: 9px; } .ds-inspector-section { padding: 12px 0 0; } .ds-inspector-section h3 { margin: 0 0 9px; color: #45495d; font-size: 10px; } .ds-inspector-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 7px; } .ds-inspector-grid label { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-inspector-grid span { font-size: 8px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-inspector-grid em { padding: 8px 7px; border: 1px solid #e7e8ef; border-radius: 8px; background: #f7f8fb; font-size: 10px; font-style: normal; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-inspector-grid label:hover em { border-color: #8994ef; background: #fff; } .ds-axis-x { color: #244be5; } .ds-axis-y { color: #168966; } .ds-axis-z { color: #c96730; }

narrative.overview:
ROOMA behaves like a working architectural model laid on a bright drafting surface, not like a conventional dashboard. The room remains the visual lead; compact operating controls frame it without competing with its geometry.

The system borrows SketchUp's immediate legibility through single-color edges, white object bodies, sparse same-hue fills, and stable orthographic isometric composition. Blue, red, green, and colorless treatments are complete representation modes: each mode changes the canvas atmosphere, line work, grid, measurements, control accents, and selected fills as one coordinated study.
keyCharacteristics: White drafting surfaces with fine neutral separators.
Single-color architectural edges and restrained same-hue fills.
A full-height model canvas framed by narrow, task-specific controls.
Dense but legible measurements, properties, and operating feedback.
Stable 2D, orthographic isometric, and perspective representations.

rules.name: The Whole-Study Rule
rules.body: A color mode changes the canvas, line work, grid, measurements, active controls, and sparse fills together.

rules.name: The Paper Majority Rule
rules.body: White and near-white surfaces occupy most of the interface; saturated color is reserved for geometry, state, and spatial meaning.

rules.name: The Instrument Label Rule
rules.body: Small type gains clarity through weight, tabular numerals, and selective tracking; it never relies on size alone to carry hierarchy.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Operating Rule
rules.body: Static shell regions separate with hairlines; shadows identify controls that float, move, or respond above the model.

dos: Do keep the room model as the dominant full-height work surface.
Do switch blue, red, green, and colorless modes as coordinated whole-interface studies.
Do use white bodies, colored edges, and sparse same-hue fills to explain form before material realism.
Do keep controls compact and attach dense metadata directly to the task it clarifies.
Do preserve orthographic geometry and locked rotation in isometric and plan views.
donts: Don't scatter multiple accent families across one model study.
Don't replace line-first spatial clarity with photorealistic textures or decorative gradients.
Don't turn the operating surface into a card dashboard that shrinks the room canvas.
Don't use persistent heavy shadows on static shell regions.
Don't hide measurement units, focus visibility, or the selected state of tools and representation modes.
